guide: Open Start and type your company name, your planning cost per km, your wanted and lowest margin, the km one truck should drive per month and the cost of an hour of waiting time in the yellow cells.
Check Trucks, Drivers, Customers and Lanes. Keep the same names and ids as in the other parts of the Trucking suite so every page finds the right phone and rate.
Each month enter the costs and the km on Cost per Km by Month. The total cost, the cost per km driven and per loaded km, the profit and the break-even revenue fill in by themselves.
Use Cost per Km by Truck and Truck Profit by Month to see which truck costs most per km and which trucks drive fewer km than their break-even.
Read Lane Profitability and Lanes to Raise or Drop every quarter: a lane with a long empty return shows its empty km cost and a plain action (keep, raise the rate, find a backhaul or drop).
Read Rate Floor by Lane before the dispatcher books: the floor rate and the target rate per km come from the real cost of each lane.
Use Customer Profitability for the rate talks, and log every request on Rate Requests with the asked rate, the start date and the answer.
Keep Cost Categories, Fixed Costs and Overhead and Driver Cost per Km current so the split between variable and fixed cost and the driver cost per km stay true.
Type a change on Price Swing Scenarios (diesel, pay, repairs, tolls, km) and read the new cost per km and the change in margin; add notes on Cost Trend Notes whenever something moves the cost.

Use the 14 calculators: cost per km, cost per loaded km, load profit, break-even rate, floor rate, fixed cost per km, break-even km, lane compare, empty km, fuel price, driver pay, truck profit, adding a truck and a rate and cost grid.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text already written (28 messages).

Read Costs and Profit Dashboard and Charts every month: cost per km, margin, the lanes and customers that lose money, empty km cost and break-even per truck. Rates and costs are demo numbers: check your own.

listing.title: Trucking Cost per Km and Lane Profitability Excel Template: Load Profit, Rate Floor, Customer Margin, Break-even per Truck
listing.headline: Know what a km really costs and which lanes lose money
listing.description:
Find out what every km costs your small carrier in one Excel workbook, from one owner-driver up to about eight trucks. Cost per Km by Month adds fuel, driver pay, repairs, tyres, tolls, insurance, truck payments and overhead over the km you drive, and gives the cost per km driven, the cost per loaded km, the profit and the break-even revenue.

Load Profit shows about three hundred loads with every cost share, so you see the loads that lose money. Lane Profitability prices the empty km of each lane and gives profit per km driven and margin, Rate Floor by Lane turns the cost of each lane into a break-even rate, a floor rate and a target rate for the dispatcher, and Lanes to Raise or Drop gives a plain action for each lane.

Customer Profitability adds invoice advance fees and waiting time, Cost per Km by Truck ranks the trucks and shows the break-even km of each, Truck Profit by Month, Equipment Profitability and Driver Cost per Km complete the picture, and Price Swing Scenarios shows what diesel, pay, repair and toll changes do to the cost per km and the margin. Cost Categories, Fixed Costs and Overhead, Rate Requests and Cost Trend Notes keep the story.

14 calculators cover cost per km, load profit, break-even rate, floor rate, fixed cost per km, break-even km, lane compare, empty km, fuel price, driver pay, truck profit, adding a truck and a rate and cost grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages with the details already written in.

This is part seven of the Trucking suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small fleet to explore first. Money is shown in one plain currency and distances in km or miles. It helps you plan and does not promise results.

de.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 10 Dokumente aus, befolgen Sie 10 Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um einen Chat mit dem bereits geschriebenen Text zu öffnen (28 Nachrichten).

de.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle Auswahllisten dieser Datei. Ändere hier einen Eintrag, und er wird in allen Tabellen übernommen.
de.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wird anhand deiner Tabellen aktualisiert. Ändere das Jahr, um frühere Daten anzusehen.
de.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Wähle die gelbe Zelle aus; der Rest wird automatisch ausgefüllt. Druckbereit.
de.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Bearbeite den Text hier; Wörter in {Klammern} werden aus jeder Zeile übernommen. Die Verknüpfungen findest du in den Tabellen.

de.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Aktuelle Diagramme deiner Tabellen. Wähle die gelben Zellen aus, und alle Diagramme und Messanzeigen werden automatisch aktualisiert.
